reason: The report rests on a single unadjusted cross-sectional OLS of 2023 productivity on training hours, with no controls even though the codebook supplies pre-period confounders (firm size, 2020 productivity, age, R&D, ownership, credit score) that plausibly drive both training and productivity, yet it draws a causal 'positive effect' conclusion. I could not re-run the code (shell access was denied), so the estimate is taken as reported, and the causal claim is not supported without adjustment or a design that addresses selection.
